grammar.title: 语法知识 直接引语 & 间接引语
lines: 7 怎么转述别人的话 直接引语、间接引语& 宾语从句？ 宾语从句：句子作宾语。 主句”一般现在“，从句”任何时态“结论：间接引语 属于 宾语从句。 反义疑问句 § C.组织步骤: 动 → 反 → 换
直接引语 间接引语
“Anhong, I miss you.” He says he misses you.
转换 直接引语 间接引语
人称转变 I He/She/You
指示代词 this that
these those
时间状语 now then
today that day
yesterday the day before
tomorrow the next day
区别 直接引语 间接引语
英语书面 He says to me , ' I’ve found my wallet. ' He tells me (that) he has found his wallet.
美语书面 She says , " You can sit here, Jim. " She tells Jim (that) he can sit there.
He says (that) his sister was there the day before . 主 + 谓 + 宾语
构成：陈述句 + 简短一般疑问句
It’s a nice day, is it a nice day? It’s a nice day, isn’t it? （前肯后否）
It’s not a nice day, is it ? 否定 + 肯定 （前否后肯）
陈述句 反义疑问句 结构
Chinese people were hard before, weren’t they ? 一般过去时 (be动词)
Lily is in Tokyo, isn’t she ? 一般现在时 (be动词)
Lily goes to school on foot, doesn’t she ? 一般现在 (助动词 do)
Sam had a meeting last night, didn’t he ? 一般过去时 (助动词 do)
Lily can’t speak French, can she ? (情态动词 can)
Sam must stay at the hotel, mustn’t he ? (情态动词 must)
You have finished your work, haven’t you ? 现在完成时 (助动词 have)
Sam hasn’t had his lunch, has he ? 现在完成 (助动词 has)

sentences.title: 单词句型 宾语从句：句子作宾语
lines: 6 宾语从句语用功能
句型 主语 谓语 宾语
简单句 I love you.
复合句 I think I love you.
主句一般现在，从句随便。
I think (that) he is awful. (从句一般现在)
He says (that) he loved her. (从句一般过去)
He knows (that) she has gone . (从句现在完成)
He is sorry (that) he will leave . (从句一般将来)
表达观点 引述话语 (间接引语)
I think that… I believe that… He says that…

expand.title: 扩展知识 书信格式
lines: 4 每日习语 The higher you go, the further you see. 站得越高，看得远。
写信人地址
写信人日期
收信人地址
称呼 Dear…,Dear Mr. …,
正文内容 A.I am very glad to hear from you. 很高兴收到你的来信。 B.I’m writing to tell you that… 我写信想告诉你… C.I’m sorry it has taken me a long time to reply.很抱歉这么久才给你回信。
常用结束语 A.I hope you are all well. 希望你一切顺利。 B. Best wishes to you.送上我最美好的祝福。 C. I’m looking forward to your reply. 期待你回信。
段落前无空格,落款在左 Yours sincerely, Venus 段落前空2格,落款在右 Yours, Venus
